title: Co-Existence and the End of Co-Intelligence
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: It has been two years since *Co-Intelligence*, my book about AI, was published, and it was successfu

So let me get this out of the way first: yes, I wrote the book. I assume you wanted to read it because you wanted to know what I, a human author doing research on the subject, thinks about AI. Similarly, I only wanted to write this book so that I could share my authentic views about AI in my voice.
